name: Content Operations Factory
description: Turn a local brief list into a compliance hold, a revision, or an approved pack with a social cut, a newsletter cut, and a calendar slot.

parameters.content:
## Briefs
Risk flags are claims the brand will not publish: guaranteed outcomes, risk-free money, and medical claims. They are sample briefs, not live campaigns.

## Factory
Held briefs stop. Weak brand scores go back to the writer. Approved briefs leave with a social cut, a newsletter cut, and a weekday slot.
